bio.p: Andrés Lillini (Argentina, 1975) is a football coach and talent developer. He has led academy departments in Mexico, Argentina and Russia, was head coach of a Liga MX first team for two and a half years, and currently leads the youth national team programme in Mexico.

datos.p: 102 matches managed in the Mexican first division; one league final; fifteen academy players debuting under his management; development spells at Morelia, Boca Juniors, CSKA Moscow and Pumas.

materiales.p: High-resolution portraits with mandatory credit, two field photographs, the program logo in light and dark versions, and a career summary in PDF.

entrevistas.p: Write through the contact form choosing the Press and media topic. State the outlet, format, estimated duration and deadline; we reply within 24 business hours.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Program, store, shipping, open call and privacy.

edad.q: How old do I need to be to apply to the program?
edad.a: We assess players aged 12 to 21. Applicants under 18 need consent from a parent or legal guardian as part of the form.

costo.q: How much does it cost to apply?
costo.a: Nothing. The application and the initial assessment are free. If you move on to an in-person session, we'll tell you in advance which costs the program covers.

video.q: What should the highlights video show?
video.a: Five to eight minutes of real match play, not just goals: off-the-ball movement, duels, decisions under pressure. A well-framed phone video is enough.

pedido.q: How long does my order take?
pedido.a: Three to five business days within Mexico once payment is confirmed. You'll get a tracking number by email.

devolucion.a: Yes, within 30 calendar days, unused and in its original packaging. We cover the return shipping if the mistake was ours.

propuestas.q: Can I send more than one entry to the open call?
propuestas.a: No. Each participant may send a single entry; if you send two, we consider the first one valid.

datosMenor.q: What do you do with a minor's data?
datosMenor.a: It is used solely for the sporting assessment, stored encrypted for the duration of the open call, and deleted at the guardian's request at any time.

patrocinios.label: Sponsorship
patrocinios.title: Sponsorship and partnerships
patrocinios.lead: How to work with a project that serves players aged 12 to 21.

ofrecemos.p: Presence at trials, documentary content of the development process, and access to an audience concentrated among families, clubs and Spanish-speaking sports media.

formatos.p: Named scholarship sponsorship, sports equipment supply, logistical support at regional trials, and co-production of educational content for coaches.

noHacemos.p: We do not sell minors' data, we do not place betting or alcohol brands in materials aimed at players, and we do not sell promises of a transfer.

siguiente.p: Write through the contact form with the Sponsorship topic. We'll send the dossier with reach, audited figures and the season's activity calendar.

privacidad.label: Privacy
privacidad.title: Privacy notice
privacidad.lead: What data we collect, what we use it for, and how to exercise your rights.

responsable.p: The controller of personal data collected through this site is the office of Andrés Lillini, with address in Mexico City.

datos.p: Identification and contact data, sporting data voluntarily provided in the program form, and billing and shipping data in the case of store purchases.

menores.p: Every application from a person under 18 requires the express consent of their parent or legal guardian, including full name, relationship and a verifiable means of contact.

consentimientoTutor.p: The form determines minority from the date of birth and, if the applicant is a minor, will not accept submission without the guardian's full name, relationship, a contact phone number and express authorisation ticked separately from the other consents. That data is recorded together with the submission date. Before any in-person activity we contact the guardian through that channel to confirm the authorisation.

finalidades.p: Assessing sporting applications, managing orders, responding to contact requests and, if you authorise it, sending you the newsletter. We do not sell or transfer data to third parties for advertising purposes.

conservacion.p: Order data is retained for as long as the tax obligation to keep accounting records lasts, even if you cancel your account. In that case the email address and shipping address are deleted, and only amounts, dates and status remain, which identify no one.

encargados.p: Payments are processed by Stripe, the database and storage are hosted on Supabase, and the site is served from Vercel. Each one processes the data solely to provide us with that service.

derechos.p: You may request access, rectification, cancellation or objection to the processing of your data through the rights form on this site. Before releasing or deleting information we verify the identity of the requester. We handle requests within a maximum of twenty business days.

conCuenta.p: From the privacy section of your account you can download all your data and cancel the account immediately, with no waiting. Forms you submitted without being signed in are handled through the rights form.

terminos.label: Terms
terminos.title: Terms and conditions
terminos.lead: Conditions of use for the site, the store and the athlete program.

uso.p: The content of this site is informational. Applying to the program does not guarantee an in-person assessment, selection, a contract or sporting representation of any kind.

pagos.p: Prices are shown in Mexican pesos with taxes included. Payment is processed on an external gateway; we do not store card details on our servers.

envios.p: Standard shipping of three to five business days within Mexico. We accept returns within thirty calendar days, with the product unused and in its original packaging.

propiedad.p: The program's methodological materials, texts and trademarks belong to their owner and may not be reproduced for commercial purposes without written authorisation.

bases.label: Open call rules
bases.title: Open call rules
bases.lead: Full rules of the 2027 Development Scholarship.

quien.p: Players aged 12 to 21 resident in Mexico, without a professional contract in force at the closing date. Participation is free.

como.p: Complete the entry form and attach a file of up to 25 MB in PDF, JPG, PNG or MP4 format. Each participant may send a single entry.

criterios.p: A panel of three program assessors scores sporting potential, context and academic commitment. The decision is final and is communicated by email.

premio.p: Ten places with methodological follow-up for one year, full equipment, two in-person camps and academic support. The scholarship is personal and non-transferable.

calendario.p: The open call closes on 30 November 2026. The shortlist is published on 15 December 2026 and the final results on 20 January 2027.

programa.titulo: If he plays, we want to see him
programa.lead: One form, fifteen attributes and a real report. We assess players aged 12 to 21 in any position and any league; the video counts for more than the CV.

evaluamos.title: What we assess
evaluamos.body: Fifteen technical, physical and mental attributes, plus the player's family and academic context.

tarda.title: How long it takes
tarda.body: Ten minutes to fill in the form. A reasoned answer within 15 business days.

menores.title: Under 18
menores.body: Every application from a player under 18 requires signed consent from a legal guardian.

velocidad.d: Acceleration over the first five metres and top speed with the ball.

fuerza.d: Ability to win duels and hold the body under contact.

pase.d: Quality of the short and long ball under pressure, with both feet.

golpeo.d: Power and direction in shooting, crossing and set pieces.

atletismo.d: Coordination, jumping, change of direction and repeated-effort endurance.

iq.d: Reading space, decision-making and anticipation off the ball.

defensa.d: Pressing, covering, man-marking and recovery after losing the ball.

mecanica.d: Base technique: control, dribbling, receiving body shape and posture.

ofensivo.d: Ability to create and finish goalscoring situations.

consistencia.d: Sustained performance across a full season.

liderazgo.d: Influence on the group on and off the pitch.

aprender.d: How quickly a correction is absorbed and repeated.

pasion.d: A real bond with the game beyond the contract and the trophy cabinet.

mental.d: Response to mistakes, to being benched and to public criticism.

etica.d: What the player does when nobody is assessing him.

entrenadores.title: Coach education

beca.title: Parallel academic scholarship

requisitos.title: Technical requirements
requisitos.body: PDF, JPG, PNG or MP4 up to 25 MB. If your video is bigger, share a public link in the corresponding field.
